source.title: Localized Spot Patterns on the Sphere for Reaction-Diffusion Systems: Theory and Open Problems

accepted.question_text: Consider the slow differential-algebraic system for localized spot dynamics of the singularly perturbed Brusselator reaction-diffusion model on the unit sphere. The unknowns are N spot locations x_1, ..., x_N on the sphere and spot strengths S_1, ..., S_N; in slow time sigma = epsilon^2 t, the locations satisfy dx_j/dsigma = (2/A_j(S_j))(I - x_j x_j^T) sum_{i != j} S_i x_i/|x_i - x_j|^2, and the strengths are determined by the nonlinear Green-interaction constraint [I - nu(I - E_0)G]S + nu(I - E_0)chi(S) - (2E/N)e = 0, where G_ij = log|x_i - x_j| for i != j, G_ii = 0, and nu = -1/log(epsilon). Can one prove analytically, using group-theoretic methods for ODEs and stability methods analogous to those for Eulerian point vortices on a ring, the observed equilibrium and orbital-stability behavior for small N: an orbitally stable three-spot ring for N = 3; a tetrahedral four-spot configuration for N = 4; an (N - 2) + 2 configuration for N = 5, 6, 7 consisting of two antipodal polar spots and N - 2 equally spaced equatorial spots; instability of ring patterns for N >= 4; and the breakup of the N = 8 (N - 2) + 2 pattern into a twisted cuboidal configuration?
accepted.context_brief: Brusselator DAE equilibria for small spot numbers

accepted.question_text: For the full Brusselator slow spot-dynamics DAE on the unit sphere, in which N spot locations and source strengths are coupled through the logarithmic Green-interaction matrix G_ij = log|x_i - x_j| and the nonlinear strength constraint [I - nu(I - E_0)G]S + nu(I - E_0)chi(S) - (2E/N)e = 0, what computational relationship, if any, exists for N >= 10 between equilibria that have large basins of attraction and elliptic Fekete point sets, meaning global minimizers on the unit sphere of the discrete logarithmic energy V = -sum_{i != j} log|x_i - x_j| with |x_j| = 1?
accepted.context_brief: Fekete point sets and large-basin equilibria

accepted.question_text: For the Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion model on the unit sphere, v_t = epsilon^2 Delta_S v - v + B u v^2 and tau u_t = D Delta_S u + (1 - u) - u v^2, in the singular limit epsilon -> 0 with B = O(epsilon/nu) and nu = -1/log(epsilon), the derived slow dynamics for localized spots couples spot locations x_j and strengths S_j through the reduced-wave Green function G satisfying Delta_S G - D^{-1}G = -delta(x - xi) and G(x; xi) approximately -(1/(2pi)) log|x - xi| + R near xi. How can one investigate the dynamics and equilibria of localized spot patterns on the sphere for this Gray-Scott DAE when the reduced-wave Green function and its regular part R are not available in a simple explicit form?
accepted.context_brief: Gray-Scott spot dynamics on the sphere

accepted.question_text: On a compact surface of revolution for which the source-neutral Green function is analytically available, with that Green function satisfying Delta_S G = |Omega|^{-1} - delta(x - x_0), can one derive and analyze explicit differential-algebraic spot dynamics for localized reaction-diffusion spots on a manifold with varying curvature, including whether curvature can pin localized spots?
accepted.context_brief: DAE spot dynamics on varying-curvature manifolds

accepted.question_text: For the localized-spot Brusselator framework on the sphere, how does allowing a spatially heterogeneous fuel supply E = E(x), rather than a constant fuel parameter, change the slow DAE dynamics? In particular, can one derive and analyze the resulting nonlocal spot-evolution system when the outer inhibitor field includes v_p = integral_Omega (E(xi) - Ebar) G(x; xi) dxi, where Ebar is the spatial average of E over the sphere?

For a model that couples passive bulk diffusion inside the sphere to a Brusselator reaction-diffusion PDE on the spherical surface, with the fuel supply E representing an exchange or flux between surface-bound concentrations and bulk concentrations, what DAE dynamics and localized spot-pattern behavior arise on the sphere?

trace.notes: Normalized the single input https://zbmath.org/6680594 as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 6680594. Local shard metadata identified the exact work as 'Localized Spot Patterns on the Sphere for Reaction-Diffusion Systems: Theory and Open Problems' with DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-30379-6_58.

Classified zbMATH as a bibliographic resolver. Local shell fetching of the zbMATH API failed because DNS resolution is unavailable in the sandbox. Bounded exact-work recovery by title and DOI found metadata pages and then the author-posted PDF at https://www.math.ubc.ca/~ward/papers/spot_short.pdf. The PDF title, authors, and abstract match the zbMATH title and DOI metadata, so the PDF was used as the readable primary source. No open problem was extracted from resolver metadata, abstracts, or snippets.

Mapped the 10-page PDF. Page 1 contains title, authors, abstract, and introduction. Pages 3-4 define the Brusselator model and the DAE system for slow spot dynamics. Pages 5-8 discuss equilibria of the DAE dynamics and open questions, including configurations for N = 3 through N = 10 and elliptic Fekete point sets. Pages 8-9 introduce the Gray-Scott model and its reduced-wave-Green-function DAE. Page 9 lists open-problem extensions for complex models: surfaces of revolution and curvature, heterogeneous fuel supply, and coupled surface-bulk models.
Scanned introduction and Brusselator DAE setup for definitions needed to rewrite later open problems. No standalone open problem was extracted from these setup sections.

Extracted the explicit open problem on analytical proof of equilibrium and ring-stability results for small N, and the explicit open problem on computational exploration of the relation between large-basin equilibria and elliptic Fekete point sets for N >= 10.

Extracted the implicit open problem that the Gray-Scott spot-dynamics DAE on the sphere requires further investigation because the reduced-wave Green function and regular part are not available in simple explicit form.

Extracted three open-problem extensions from the section titled 'DAE Spot Dynamics in Complex Models: Open Problems': DAE dynamics on varying-curvature surfaces of revolution, heterogeneous fuel supply E(x), and coupled surface-bulk Brusselator dynamics.

Expanded the source's cross-reference to 'these results' by restating the relevant DAE variables, Green-interaction constraint, and the small-N equilibrium and stability behavior described immediately before the open-problem statement.

Expanded the computational Fekete-point question by defining elliptic Fekete point sets using the source's discrete logarithmic energy and by identifying the full DAE as the Brusselator Green-interaction spot-dynamics system.
Expanded the Gray-Scott further-investigation statement by inlining the Gray-Scott model equations, the scaling assumption, and the reduced-wave Green function obstacle stated in the source.
Rewrote the surfaces-of-revolution extension as a question about deriving and analyzing DAE dynamics on varying-curvature manifolds, including the source's stated possibility of spot pinning.
Rewrote the heterogeneous-fuel extension as a self-contained question and inlined the source's nonlocal outer-field term involving E(x), its spatial average, and the Green function.
Rewrote the coupled surface-bulk extension as a question about deriving DAE dynamics when the fuel supply is an exchange or flux between surface-bound and bulk concentrations.
